blocking.heading: When you select a technical noun
blocking.text: Remove the label in angle brackets from these lines.
blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 73, "label" has the meaning "text in angle brackets at the start of a prompt line", but the base list in technical-terms.md gives "label" the meaning "A name that you attach to an issue or a pull request", so one technical noun has two items.
blocking.correction: Remove the text in angle brackets at the start of these lines, for example "<For the loading reviewer only:>".

blocking.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
blocking.text: In each round, start 3 new reviewer subagents for the sections in the `Changes:` line, one of each class, as "When you do a round" tells you:
blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, line 61 tells the main agent to start 3 reviewers, but the necessary condition and step that change this action come after it at line 71 ("When you start the reviewers, find the list files..." and "When each changed file is a list file, start only the ASD-STE100 reviewer and the ISO 24495-1 reviewer in each round."), so an agent that does the steps in sequence can start the loading reviewer before it finds the list files.
blocking.correction: Move the first 3 sentences of line 71 before line 61, and write line 61 as: "Before you start the reviewers, find the list files in "Terms in this skill" in `SKILL.md`. Give no list file in the `Changes:` line of the loading reviewer. When each changed file is a list file, start only the ASD-STE100 reviewer and the ISO 24495-1 reviewer in each round. In the other rounds, start 3 new reviewer subagents for the sections in the `Changes:` line, one of each class, as "When you do a round" tells you:"

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: A script compares each quote with the files and removes each finding with a different quote.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 140, the noun "quote" is not in the glossary or in the base list, but the base list gives "quoted text" for text that the author copies from a source.
advisory.correction: A script compares each quoted text with the files and removes each finding with a different quoted text.
